text: HEADLINEBAND — THE FIGURES A DASHBOARD OPENS WITH. One `HeadlineFigure` drawn large and up to a few beside it, on the dashboard's colour, named in the outline by a visually hidden heading (`title`). A figure that leads a card further down can link to it (`href`, `linkAs`). One column below 1024px. Extracted unchanged from the Beneficiary Dashboard's At a Glance band. In Figma: the Dashboard page — Figures None | One | Four, Code Connect.
